interfaces.signature: Page: forum-feed(index) — onLoad() → loads categories + paginated posts via mp-services; onPullDownRefresh() → reloads; onReachBottom() → loads next page
postconditions: Category tabs rendered at top
Post list rendered with post-card components
LoadState managed: idle→loading→loaded|empty|error

failure_modes.trigger: Network error during post list fetch
failure_modes.behavior: setData({state: 'error', errorMessage: '加载失败'}). <error-view> shown with retry button.
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws → page catch block → LoadState='error'. Retry calls onLoad() again.

test_contracts.scenario: Network offline shows error state with retry
Empty category shows empty state with CTA
test_contracts.verifies: Empty state renders message + 'create first post' button

interfaces.signature: Page: chat-room — onLoad(conversationId) → opens mp-watch subscription; onUnload() → closes watcher; onSend(content) → calls mp-services.messages.send()
postconditions: Real-time message list rendered with chat-bubble components
New messages arrive via watch without manual refresh
Sent messages show 'sent' status immediately

failure_modes.trigger: watch() onError fires (subscription limit exceeded, network loss)
failure_modes.behavior: Fall back to polling mode: setInterval calls messages.getConversation() every 5s. Show '连接不稳定' banner.
failure_modes.propagation: mp-watch onError → page switches to polling fallback. Banner shown until watch recovers.

test_contracts.scenario: Watch fails, falls back to polling
test_contracts.verifies: Polling starts after watch error, banner shown

extension_points: New pages added via app.json pages array + subpackage config. Page lifecycle follows WeChat onLoad/onShow/onHide/onUnload contract.
sealed_points: Pages never call wx.cloud.* directly — always through mp-services. Pages manage LoadState explicitly for every data-fetching path.
state_owned: Current page data (posts list, messages list, scroll position, LoadState per view)

interfaces.signature: post-card: properties={post: Post, showCategory: boolean} → renders title, excerpt, author avatar, category tag, comment count, timestamp
preconditions: Post object has required fields: _id, title, content, author.nickname, category_id, comment_count, created_at
postconditions: Card rendered with all visible fields
Tap emits 'select' event with {postId}

failure_modes.trigger: post.author.avatar_url is missing or empty
failure_modes.behavior: Render <avatar> component with default placeholder image. No crash.
failure_modes.propagation: Handled internally via wx:if conditional in WXML.

test_contracts.scenario: Post with missing avatar renders default
test_contracts.verifies: Default avatar shown, no console error

interfaces.signature: chat-bubble: properties={message: Message, isMine: boolean} → renders bubble aligned left/right, content text, timestamp, status icon
preconditions: Message object has: content, created_at, status
isMine is correctly set by parent
postconditions: Bubble rendered with correct alignment
Status icon shows: pending -> sent -> delivered (if implemented)

interfaces.signature: comment-item: properties={comment: Comment, depth: number} → renders author, content, timestamp, reply button (hidden if depth>=1)
preconditions: Comment has: author.nickname, content, created_at, depth
postconditions: Comment rendered with indent for depth=1
Reply button visible only when depth < 1
Tap reply emits 'reply' event with {commentId, authorName}

interfaces.signature: empty-state: properties={icon: string?, message: string, actionLabel: string?} → renders centered icon + message + optional action button
postconditions: Empty state rendered
If actionLabel set, button shown. Tap emits 'action' event.

interfaces.signature: error-view: properties={message: string, retryLabel: string?} → renders error icon + message + retry button
postconditions: Error view rendered
Retry button tap emits 'retry' event

interfaces.signature: nav-bar: properties={title: string, showBack: boolean} → custom navigation bar (Skyline requires custom nav)
postconditions: Custom nav bar rendered with title and optional back arrow
Back tap calls wx.navigateBack()

interfaces.signature: avatar: properties={src: string, size: string} → renders circular avatar image with fallback
postconditions: Avatar rendered at specified size
Broken image shows default placeholder

interfaces.signature: loading-skeleton: properties={type: 'post-card'|'chat-bubble'|'comment', count: number} → renders skeleton placeholder rows
postconditions: Skeleton rows rendered matching count
CSS animation for shimmer effect

interfaces.signature: category-tag: properties={name: string, active: boolean} → renders styled category label
postconditions: Tag rendered with category name
Active state uses --color-primary background

extension_points: New components added in components/ directory, Glass-Easel Chaining API for TypeScript support
sealed_points: All components use static styleIsolation: 'apply-shared' (Skyline requirement). No direct CloudBase SDK calls in any component. Data flows IN via properties, OUT via triggerEvent.
state_owned: Component-local UI state (expanded/collapsed, image preview mode)

interfaces.signature: auth.ensureUser() -> Promise<User> — calls cf-login, caches profile in wx.Storage
postconditions: User document exists in db-users
User profile cached locally
Returns User object

failure_modes.trigger: Cloud function call fails (network, cloud function error)
failure_modes.behavior: Throw CloudError with code and message. Caller handles retry.
failure_modes.propagation: Caller (app.ts or page) catches and shows error UI with retry.

interfaces.signature: posts.list(params: {categoryId?, status?, offset, limit}) -> Promise<{items: Post[], total: number}> — direct DB read from db-posts
postconditions: Paginated post list with denormalized author data
Filtered by category and status='published'

failure_modes.trigger: Database permission denied (unexpected — published posts are public-read)
failure_modes.behavior: Return empty items array. Log error.
failure_modes.propagation: Page renders empty state. Error logged for investigation.

interfaces.signature: posts.create(data: {title, content, categoryId}) -> Promise<Post> — calls cf-posts cloud function
postconditions: Post created with status 'published' or 'flagged' (if sensitive words detected)
Author data denormalized into post document

failure_modes.trigger: Content contains sensitive words
failure_modes.behavior: Post created with status='flagged'. Return post with warning flag. Author sees 'under review' badge.
failure_modes.propagation: Cloud function returns {post, flagged: true}. Service passes through to page. Page shows confirmation with moderation notice.

test_contracts.scenario: Post with sensitive word is flagged

failure_modes.trigger: Rate limit exceeded (>10 posts per hour per user)
failure_modes.behavior: Cloud function returns 429 error. Service throws RateLimitError with retryAfter.
failure_modes.propagation: Page catches → shows toast with cooldown timer.

test_contracts.scenario: 11th post in one hour is rate limited

interfaces.signature: posts.search(query: string, offset: number, limit: number) -> Promise<{items: Post[], total: number}> — calls cf-posts with action='search'
postconditions: Posts matching query via RegExp on title+content. Ranked by created_at desc.

interfaces.signature: comments.byPost(postId: string) -> Promise<Comment[]> — direct DB read, then client-side tree building
postconditions: All published comments for post. Tree built in-memory: top-level comments with nested replies array.

interfaces.signature: comments.create(data: {postId, content, parentId?}) -> Promise<Comment> — calls cf-comments cloud function
preconditions: parentId (if set) references comment on same post with depth=0
postconditions: Comment created with depth computed
Post comment_count incremented

failure_modes.trigger: parentId references depth=1 comment (attempting 3rd level)
failure_modes.behavior: Cloud function returns 400. Service throws MaxDepthError.
failure_modes.propagation: Page shows toast '回复已达最大深度'.

test_contracts.scenario: Reply to level-2 comment is rejected

interfaces.signature: messages.send(data: {to: string, content: string, msgId: string}) -> Promise<MessageDeliveryResult> — calls cf-messages cloud function
preconditions: to is a valid user openid
postconditions: Message persisted with status='sent'
If recipient has active watch, delivered via real-time push
Idempotent: duplicate msgId returns existing message status

failure_modes.trigger: Recipient user does not exist
failure_modes.behavior: Cloud function returns 404. Service throws UserNotFoundError.
failure_modes.propagation: Page shows toast '用户不存在'.

interfaces.signature: messages.getConversations() -> Promise<Conversation[]> — calls cf-messages cloud function
postconditions: List of conversations grouped by other user. Each: {peer: UserBrief, lastMessage: Message, unreadCount: number}.

interfaces.signature: messages.getConversation(peerOpenid: string, beforeId?: string, limit?: number) -> Promise<Message[]> — calls cf-messages cloud function
postconditions: Paginated message history between current user and peer. Ordered by created_at desc.

interfaces.signature: categories.list() -> Promise<Category[]> — direct DB read from db-categories
postconditions: All active categories ordered by sort_order. Includes post_count.

interfaces.signature: users.getProfile(openid: string) -> Promise<UserPublic> — direct DB read from db-users (public fields only)
postconditions: User public profile: nickname, avatar_url, role. Excludes sensitive fields.

interfaces.signature: users.updateProfile(data: {nickname?, avatar_url?}) -> Promise<User> — calls cf-users cloud function
postconditions: Profile updated. cf-users syncs denormalized author data to existing posts/comments (eventually consistent).

extension_points: New service modules added per domain: services/notifications.ts, services/reports.ts, etc.
sealed_points: All CloudBase SDK calls go through this layer. Pages never import wx.cloud directly. Service functions return typed promises — no raw SDK responses leak to pages.
state_owned: Pending request count (for global loading indicator)

interfaces.signature: watch.postsByCategory(categoryId: string, onChange: WatchCallback<Post>, onError: WatchErrorCallback) -> WatcherHandle
postconditions: Watch subscription active on posts collection filtered by category_id and status='published'
Returns handle with close() method

failure_modes.trigger: Subscription limit exceeded or network loss
failure_modes.behavior: onError callback invoked with error details. Caller decides fallback strategy (polling).
failure_modes.propagation: onError → page handler → switch to polling mode. Watcher handle is null.

interfaces.signature: watch.commentsByPost(postId: string, onChange: WatchCallback<Comment[]>, onError: WatchErrorCallback) -> WatcherHandle
postconditions: Watch subscription active on comments collection filtered by post_id and status='published'
Returns handle with close() method

interfaces.signature: watch.messagesBetween(peerOpenid: string, onChange: WatchCallback<Message[]>, onError: WatchErrorCallback) -> WatcherHandle
postconditions: Watch subscription active on messages collection where (from=me AND to=peer) OR (from=peer AND to=me)
Returns handle with close() method

failure_modes.trigger: messages collection permission is admin-only — watch subscription may fail if not called via cloud function proxy
failure_modes.behavior: Watch works because the subscription uses the authenticated user's openid — CloudBase applies the same permission model. Since messages are admin-only, watch on messages MUST be done differently: subscribe to a 'message_notifications' cache collection that a cloud function writes to. Or: keep messages admin-only and use polling instead of watch.
failure_modes.propagation: Design note: messages collection watch requires architectural decision. Option A: change messages permission to 'creator read/write' and dual-write. Option B: use polling. Option C: notification cache collection. See BC-008.

test_contracts.verifies: Design handles messages permission model correctly

interfaces.signature: WatcherHandle.close() -> void — closes the watch subscription
preconditions: WatcherHandle was returned from a watch.* call
postconditions: Subscription closed. No further onChange calls. Resources released.

extension_points: Additional watch targets: presence collection, notification collection
sealed_points: ponytail: page-scoped lifecycle. One watch per active page. Always call close() in onUnload. Messages watch design TBD based on permission model decision.

interfaces.signature: formatTime(date: Date | string) -> string — returns relative time (刚刚/5分钟前/3小时前/2天前/2024-01-15)
preconditions: date is a valid Date or ISO string or CloudBase serverDate
postconditions: Human-readable relative or absolute time string

interfaces.signature: storage.get<T>(key: string) -> T | null — typed wx.Storage read
postconditions: Parsed value or null if not found/corrupt

interfaces.signature: storage.set<T>(key: string, value: T) -> void — typed wx.Storage write
postconditions: Value JSON-serialized and stored

interfaces.signature: type LoadState = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'loaded' | 'empty' | 'error'
postconditions: Type used by all pages for consistent state management

interfaces.signature: debounce<T extends (...args: any[]) => any>(fn: T, ms: number) -> T — debounce utility for search input
postconditions: Function called at most once per ms milliseconds

extension_points: New pure utility functions added as needed
sealed_points: No business logic. No CloudBase SDK calls. Pure functions + typed storage wrapper only.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'ensure', nickname?: string, avatar_url?: string}, context: CloudContext) -> Promise<{user: User}>
preconditions: context.OPENID is available (WeChat runtime guarantees this)
postconditions: User document exists in db-users (created on first call)
Returns user profile with _openid, nickname, avatar_url, role

failure_modes.trigger: context.OPENID is empty or undefined (should never happen)
failure_modes.behavior: Return {error: 'IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE', code: 'AUTH_FAILED'}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services auth.ts receives error, throws CloudError. App shows 'please restart mini-program'.

sealed_points: Only authentication method: context.OPENID from WeChat runtime. No password, no email, no SSO. User creation is automatic on first call.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'create', title: string, content: string, category_id: string}, context) -> Promise<{post: Post, flagged?: boolean}>
postconditions: Post created in db-posts with denormalized author data from db-users
Category post_count incremented
Status set based on sensitive word check

failure_modes.trigger: Content matches sensitive word filter
failure_modes.behavior: Post created with status='flagged'. Response includes {flagged: true}. Post not visible in public listings.
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services receives flagged:true. Page shows 'under review' confirmation to author.

failure_modes.trigger: Category does not exist
failure_modes.behavior: Return 400 {error: 'INVALID_CATEGORY', code: 'BAD_REQUEST'}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws ValidationError. Page shows '分类不存在'.

failure_modes.trigger: Rate limit exceeded — user exceeded max posts per hour
failure_modes.behavior: Return 429 {error: 'RATE_LIMITED', code: 'RATE_LIMITED', retry_after: seconds}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws RateLimitError. Page shows cooldown timer.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'search', query: string, offset: number, limit: number}, context) -> Promise<{items: Post[], total: number}>
postconditions: Posts where title OR content matches query via db.RegExp({regexp: query, options: 'i'})

sealed_points: Soft-delete only (status='deleted'). Posts never hard-deleted. Title 200 char limit. Content 10000 char limit. Sensitive word filter always applied on create and update.
state_owned: Per-user rate counter (in-memory Map<openid, {count, window_start}>). ponytail: in-memory resets on cold start. Add DB-backed counters if abuse becomes problem.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'create', post_id: string, content: string, parent_id?: string}, context) -> Promise<{comment: Comment}>
preconditions: parent_id (if set) references existing comment on same post with depth=0
postconditions: Comment created with depth: 0 if no parent, 1 if parent_id set
Post comment_count incremented atomically via db.command.inc(1)

failure_modes.trigger: parent_id references comment with depth=1 (attempting 3rd level nesting)
failure_modes.behavior: Return 400 {error: 'MAX_DEPTH', code: 'MAX_DEPTH', max: 2}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws MaxDepthError. Page shows toast and disables reply button on that comment.

failure_modes.trigger: parent_id references comment on a different post
failure_modes.behavior: Return 400 {error: 'PARENT_MISMATCH', code: 'BAD_REQUEST'}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws ValidationError. Page shows generic error.

test_contracts.scenario: Reply with wrong post parent combo

failure_modes.trigger: Post does not exist
failure_modes.behavior: Return 404 {error: 'POST_NOT_FOUND', code: 'NOT_FOUND'}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws NotFoundError.

sealed_points: Max comment depth = 2 (post → comment → reply). Content 2000 char limit. Soft-delete only. Sensitive word filter applied on create.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'send', to: string, content: string, msg_id: string}, context) -> Promise<{message: Message, status: string}>
preconditions: to is a valid user openid
postconditions: Message persisted with status='sent'
Idempotent: if msg_id already exists, return existing message (no duplicate)

failure_modes.trigger: Recipient does not exist in db-users
failure_modes.behavior: Return 404 {error: 'USER_NOT_FOUND', code: 'NOT_FOUND'}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws UserNotFoundError. Page shows toast.

failure_modes.trigger: Duplicate msg_id (client retry)
failure_modes.behavior: Return existing message document. No new document created.
failure_modes.propagation: Transparent to sender — they get the original message status.

test_contracts.verifies: No duplicate document, same status returned

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'listConversations'}, context) -> Promise<{conversations: Conversation[]}>
postconditions: Conversations grouped by peer user. Each: {peer: {_openid, nickname, avatar_url}, lastMessage: Message, unreadCount: number}. Ordered by lastMessage.created_at desc.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'getConversation', peer: string, beforeId?: string, limit?: number}, context) -> Promise<{messages: Message[], hasMore: boolean}>
preconditions: peer is a valid user openid
postconditions: Paginated messages between current user and peer. Ordered by created_at desc. Up to 50 per page.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'markRead', peer: string, msgIds?: string[]}, context) -> Promise<{updated: number}>
postconditions: Messages from peer to current user marked as status='read'. Returns count of updated messages.

extension_points: Future: group chat, message reactions, typing indicators
sealed_points: Content 5000 char limit. No file/attachment support in MVP. Messages collection permission: admin-only (all access through cloud functions). msg_id is the idempotency key.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'create', name: string, description: string}, context) -> Promise<{category: Category}>
preconditions: context.OPENID has admin role in db-users
postconditions: New category persisted with auto-incremented sort_order

failure_modes.trigger: Caller is not admin
failure_modes.behavior: Return 403 {error: 'FORBIDDEN', code: 'FORBIDDEN'}
failure_modes.propagation: mp-services throws ForbiddenError. Page shows '需要管理员权限'.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'list'}, context) -> Promise<{categories: Category[]}>
postconditions: All active categories ordered by sort_order with post_count

sealed_points: Categories are flat (no nesting). Sort order is numeric ascending. Read path: clients may read directly from db-categories (public data). Write path: cloud function only.

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'updateProfile', nickname?: string, avatar_url?: string}, context) -> Promise<{user: User}>
postconditions: User profile updated in db-users
Denormalized author data in db-posts and db-comments updated async (eventually consistent)

interfaces.signature: main(event: {action: 'getProfile', openid: string}, context) -> Promise<{user: UserPublic}>
postconditions: Public user profile: nickname, avatar_url, role

sealed_points: User role is a simple string: 'user' | 'admin'. Profile updates sync denormalized author data to posts and comments — eventual consistency, not transactional.

interfaces.signature: filterSensitiveWords(text: string) -> {clean: boolean, matches: string[]} — checks text against sensitive word list
postconditions: clean=true if no matches, clean=false with matches array if words found

interfaces.signature: validateInput(value: string, rules: {minLen?, maxLen?, pattern?}) -> {valid: boolean, error?: string}
postconditions: valid=true if input passes all rules, otherwise error message

interfaces.signature: formatResponse(data: any) -> {data: any} | formatError(error: string, code: string) -> {error: string, code: string}
postconditions: Consistent response envelope: success returns {data}, error returns {error, code}

interfaces.signature: checkAdmin(openid: string, db: Database) -> Promise<boolean> — checks if user has admin role
postconditions: True if user.role === 'admin', false otherwise

extension_points: Additional shared utilities: image moderation via ext-wechat, template message sending
sealed_points: Deployed as CloudBase '层' (layer). All other cloud functions import from this layer. No standalone invocation — utility only.
state_owned: Sensitive word list (hardcoded array in module)

interfaces.signature: Document shape: {_id: string, _openid: string, title: string, content: string, category_id: string, status: 'published'|'flagged'|'hidden'|'deleted', author: {_openid: string, nickname: string, avatar_url: string}, view_count: number, comment_count: number, created_at: Date, updated_at: Date}
Indexes: (category_id, status, created_at), (status, created_at), (_openid, created_at)
preconditions: Created via CloudBase console or cloud function migration script
postconditions: Queries filtered by category+status+time use compound index
User's own posts query uses _openid index

interfaces.signature: Permission: all users read {status:'published'} documents; creator read/write own documents; cloud functions read/write all (admin bypass)
preconditions: Configured in CloudBase console collection permissions
postconditions: Client-side reads return only published posts
Client-side writes limited to own posts

extension_points: New fields: pinned (admin), locked (no new comments), edited_at (edit history)
sealed_points: Soft-delete only (status='deleted'). No hard delete. title max 200 chars enforced by cloud function + client validation. content max 10000 chars.
state_shared: Documents are shared state. Coordination via CloudBase permission rules + cloud function logic.

interfaces.signature: Document shape: {_id: string, _openid: string, post_id: string, parent_id: string|null, depth: 0|1, content: string, author: {_openid, nickname, avatar_url}, status: 'published'|'flagged'|'deleted', created_at: Date}
Indexes: (post_id, status, created_at), (_openid, created_at)
postconditions: Comments by post query uses compound index

interfaces.signature: Permission: all users read {status:'published'}; creator read/write own; cloud functions read/write all
postconditions: Public comments visible; writes gated by creator ownership or admin role

sealed_points: Soft-delete only. max depth=2 enforced by cf-comments. content max 2000 chars.
state_shared: Documents shared. Coordination via CloudBase permissions + cloud function depth checks.

interfaces.signature: Document shape: {_id: string, msg_id: string (unique), from: string (openid), to: string (openid), content: string, status: 'sent'|'delivered'|'read', created_at: Date}
Indexes: (msg_id) unique, (from, to, created_at), (to, from, created_at)
postconditions: Idempotency via unique msg_id index
Conversation queries use from-to compound indexes

interfaces.signature: Permission: admin only (all access via cloud functions). No direct client read/write.
postconditions: Private message data protected from direct client access
All access mediated by cf-messages

sealed_points: content max 5000 chars enforced by cloud function. msg_id unique constraint enforces idempotency. Admin-only permission — no direct client access.
state_shared: Messages are private data. Access controlled entirely through cloud functions.

interfaces.signature: Document shape: {_openid: string (PK), nickname: string, avatar_url: string, role: 'user'|'admin', created_at: Date, updated_at: Date}
Indexes: (_openid) unique, (role)
postconditions: User lookup by openid uses unique index
Admin listing uses role index

interfaces.signature: Permission: all users read public fields (nickname, avatar_url, role); creator read/write own document; cloud functions read/write all
postconditions: Public profiles readable by any authenticated user
Own profile editable via cloud function

extension_points: New fields: bio, major, year (student info — opt-in)
sealed_points: _openid is the primary key — set manually (not auto-generated) to match context.OPENID. role defaults to 'user'. No password, no email.
state_shared: User documents shared across all collections via denormalized author data

interfaces.signature: Document shape: {_id: string (auto), name: string (unique), description: string, sort_order: number, post_count: number, status: 'active'|'hidden'}
Indexes: (status, sort_order)
postconditions: Active category listing sorted by sort_order

interfaces.signature: Permission: all users read; admin write (via cloud function)
postconditions: Public category data readable by any authenticated user
Writes gated by cf-categories admin check

extension_points: New fields: icon, color (for visual distinction)
sealed_points: Flat structure — no nesting. sort_order is numeric ascending. name is unique.
state_shared: Category documents referenced in posts. post_count updated atomically by cf-posts and cf-comments.

interfaces.signature: cloud.openapi.security.msgSecCheck({content, version, openid, scene, title?}) -> Promise<{result: {suggest: 'pass'|'risky'|'review', label: number}}>
preconditions: CloudBase environment has WeChat API permissions
postconditions: WeChat AI content moderation result returned

failure_modes.trigger: WeChat API call fails (rate limit, network error)
failure_modes.behavior: Cloud function catches error, falls back to local sensitive word filter only
failure_modes.propagation: Transparent to user. Post moderation uses local filter when WeChat API unavailable.

test_contracts.scenario: WeChat API unavailable, fallback to local filter
test_contracts.verifies: Local filter applied, post created normally

interfaces.signature: cloud.openapi.subscribeMessage.send({touser, templateId, data, page?}) -> Promise<void> — send template message to user
preconditions: User has subscribed to the template
postconditions: Template message delivered to user's WeChat service notification

extension_points: Additional WeChat APIs: getUserProfile, getPhoneNumber, imgSecCheck
sealed_points: External service — not owned by this project. All calls mediated by cloud functions (never called directly from client). Use cloud.call for native WeChat API integration.
